comment: Bluetooth LE 1 Mb/s advertising channel (LE 1M uncoded PHY): GFSK, BT 0.5, modulation index 0.5, a 1 the higher frequency. Preamble and access address (the delimiter finds them, the marker step strips and, transmitting, attaches them), then the PDU header, payload and CRC-24, whitened from the header on with the channel's sequence, every field least significant bit first. Out come the advertising PDU payloads whose CRC checks. The capture is one channel at `sps` samples per bit (4 MS/s: 4); the carrier offset must be small against the 250 kHz deviation (a free-running SDR's is) and comes off with the discriminator's mean. Timing is estimated on the stream, so this wants a continuous signal; a burst-by-burst receiver is projects/ble
ref: Bluetooth Core 6.0 Vol 6 Part A 3, Part B 2.1, 3.1, 3.2

channel.comment: advertising channel index (37, 38, 39): seeds the whitening
